meta.title: MCP connector toggles
meta.description: Turn existing MCP servers on or off from the sidebar's MCP connector toggles panel, between Plugins and Automation tasks. Each switch edits only that row's disabled field in your profile patch — one line is inserted when turning it off and removed when turning it back on, while every other byte of the file stays untouched — and the change applies through hot reload in about two seconds. Each server shows a short one-line intro, customized per serverName under descriptions in the profile patch; without one, the page shows a generic line and the server's current tool count. Only `- id: mcp-*` loader rows in that one file are listed, not `mcp-manager`'s `servers` map or patch layers shipped by other bundles. It makes no network requests and never reads credentials. While a server is off, its tools leave the model's tool list.
